_comment: Input for tools/build-cu26-rookies.mjs (Wildcard, Goal League S1; CoS BET-20261116-2). The four 2026 award winners and their 1st Bowman Chrome cards. Every price on the page comes from repo data at build time (data/feed/sold-marks.json key, else the class basket in data/indices.json, else a dated row in data/mlb-cards.json); none is typed here. 'updateFirstSold' per player is filled by the Dec 10 and Dec 14 re-marks with {median, n, window, asOf} from dated sold Chrome Update sales, never asks; null prints 'Starts after Dec. 9'.

release.note: SI: pre-orders 'started Monday ahead of release day on Dec. 9'; Misiorowski, Schlittler, McGonigle and Stewart each have a rookie debut patch card, 'one-of-one cards that merge a player's autograph with the debut patch'. Second read: otia.com (Nov 6 2026), 'arrives Dec. 9'. topps.com refuses cloud fetches (403), so not re-read there.
